_comment: One pre and one post hook. scripts/hooks/hook.js reads the tool payload on stdin and prints guidance only for AutomaQA-relevant commands and files (playwright test, maestro test, npm install, extract_cases, spec/report writes); every other Bash call or Write is silent. Node.js is the only runtime dependency (already required for Playwright). Informational only; fails silently if Node.js is unavailable.
